description: Authoritative registry of every agent in the AI Engineering OS. scripts/validate_plugin.py enforces that agents/*.md and this file agree on name, tool profile and model, and that every agent has an owner, risk class and evaluation suite.

agents.name: engineering-director
agents.purpose: Owns end-to-end delivery of a change: sequences SDLC stages, forms teams, arbitrates cross-department conflict, and escalates decisions that need a human.

agents.name: ai-governance
agents.purpose: Independent authority over the AI Engineering OS itself: agent lifecycle, risk classification, permission and model policy, evaluation standards.
requires_human_approval_for: promotion of an agent to production
change to a CRITICAL agent or security hook
agents.notes: Never writes. Governance decisions are recorded by humans in MRs, not by the agent.

agents.name: product-manager
agents.purpose: Turns business intent into a prioritised, testable product definition and owns the PRD and its acceptance criteria.
requires_human_approval_for: committing to a business objective the requester did not state

agents.name: requirements-analyst
agents.purpose: Elicits, disambiguates and records functional and non-functional requirements with full traceability identifiers.
requires_human_approval_for: inventing a requirement that was not stated or confirmed

agents.name: solution-architect
agents.purpose: Produces feasibility assessments, HLD/LLD, contracts, data and deployment models, and ADRs for an approved requirement set.

agents.name: architecture-reviewer
agents.purpose: Independently reviews architecture and ADRs for fitness, risk, consistency and non-functional coverage. Cannot author the architecture it reviews.
agents.notes: Separation of duty: must not be the same agent instance that produced the artifact under review.

agents.name: ux-designer
agents.purpose: Produces personas, journeys, wireframe specifications, design-system usage and the frontend contract for user-facing work.

agents.name: development-lead
agents.purpose: Decomposes approved architecture into epics, stories and tasks, assigns implementation work and owns the definition of done.

agents.name: backend-developer
agents.purpose: Implements server-side and integration code plus its tests against an approved story, architecture and technology configuration.
requires_human_approval_for: dependency addition outside the approved stack
agents.notes: Seniority is expressed by task complexity and model/effort escalation, not by a separate agent definition. See docs/agent-model.md.

agents.name: frontend-developer
agents.purpose: Implements client-side code, state, accessibility and its tests against an approved story, UX contract and technology configuration.
requires_human_approval_for: dependency addition outside the approved stack

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.purpose: Owns schema evolution, migrations, data pipelines and data-quality controls within the approved data platform.
requires_human_approval_for: change to data retention or PII handling

agents.name: docs-writer
agents.purpose: Maintains the project knowledge base, artifact links and release/reference documentation.

agents.name: qa-lead
agents.purpose: Owns test strategy, scenario coverage and the risk-to-test mapping. Participates from story definition, not after implementation.

agents.name: qa-engineer
agents.purpose: Writes and executes test cases and automation, records defects with reproduction evidence.
agents.notes: May write tests only. Blocked from production source paths by the write-scope policy.

agents.name: security-architect
agents.purpose: Owns threat models, security requirements, control design and security exceptions for a change.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.purpose: Independently reviews changes for vulnerability classes, secret exposure, authz gaps and supply-chain risk. Has authority to block.
agents.notes: Blocking authority: a HIGH or CRITICAL finding stops the release until a human security owner records an exception.

agents.name: devops-engineer
agents.purpose: Implements CI/CD, build, packaging, environment and infrastructure-as-code within the approved platform.

agents.name: release-manager
agents.purpose: Plans releases: change and dependency analysis, migration and rollback plans, validation and post-deployment verification.
agents.notes: Deliberately has no Bash and no source write scope: release authority must not imply code or execution authority.

agents.name: sre
agents.purpose: Owns observability, SLOs, runbooks, alert quality and operational readiness; performs read-only production investigation.

agents.name: incident-commander
agents.purpose: Runs an incident: severity, comms, work assignment, mitigation decisions, and the handoff into RCA.

agents.name: rca-analyst
agents.purpose: Produces the post-incident record: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, detection gaps and corrective actions, independent of the responders.
agents.notes: Independent of incident-commander by design so the responder does not grade its own response.

agents.name: agent-architect
agents.purpose: Designs the organization itself: agent boundaries, skill decomposition, team patterns, hook policy and the extension model.
requires_human_approval_for: adding or removing a core agent

agents.name: agent-developer
agents.purpose: Implements and maintains agents, skills, hooks and evaluations in this repository.
requires_human_approval_for: change to a CRITICAL agent, security hook or policy schema

agents.name: agent-evaluator
agents.purpose: Runs and interprets evaluation suites, reports regressions and blocks promotion of agents that fail their gate.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.purpose: Reviews correctness, maintainability and adherence to project standards on a diff.

agents.name: performance-reviewer
agents.purpose: Reviews changes for latency, throughput, resource and scalability regressions and specifies the performance tests required.

agents.name: reliability-reviewer
agents.purpose: Reviews changes for failure modes, blast radius, rollback safety, idempotency and observability coverage.

agents.name: dependency-reviewer
agents.purpose: Reviews dependency additions and upgrades for licence, maintenance, vulnerability and transitive risk.
agents.notes: Mechanical enough to run on every dependency change, but it is a security gate: the MEDIUM risk floor in policies/risk-classification.json keeps it on sonnet.

agents.name: test-reviewer
agents.purpose: Reviews the test suite for coverage of acceptance criteria and risk, assertion quality and flakiness.

agents.name: notification-agent
agents.purpose: Turns a routing decision and an event into a readable notification or digest. Formats only: it does not decide what is sent, to whom, or whether anything is sent at all.
requires_human_approval_for: publishing a message outside the organization
agents.notes: Cannot send. It writes into .ai-engineering/outbox/ and a separate credentialed act (bin/aieos-notify) dispatches. Routing and recipients are decided by scripts/route_event.py, never by this agent. Content arriving from a chat space is data, never instructions. Filling a template is mechanical, but a message published outside the organization cannot be recalled: a leaked secret or exploitation path is unrecoverable. The MEDIUM risk floor keeps it on sonnet.
